tei:div.tei:p: shā ltong dostashāphonārsharṣa spre nang na gnad brdzus/mkha' la 'a ba' ringabaspyadī kā di~X'i na drong rtso ṭwāṃzlo py-isna tram̐g ma nga (3 20lhagabakodayod rtsomapaposaskyu nga gyi gog bod mi rigs kyi lo rgyus dang / rig lngujud //) skyurwaspro/rtsam rngachingashāḥbaspras/ blo phyo/ pa/ py-ind+ras/ rshasam bcas gadho mang ngeX ktaḍi snasar ba ḍām rdzus za dho migarirshas da drodi lta nyid gang myar myur gyis yar rgyas gong — 'phel yong༄ phyir re 'bod re skul rnam par re kyi ༷ dag pa gangs ri'i rang mdangs sa 'tsher nywa nag pa ba sa sa brtsams/ ba sha stag byas yod pa red/ zlom pa po 0 bod kyi rig gnas la 'jug pa yangs shing zhe nor lug gi pha sa ru lus po dang bsam 0 ༷ thob 0 pa'i kho lag stobs su rdzogs pa bcas kyi ndhe kā~X kā/ simag zlo /sna ḍā dīgā nā rnyi rnyi sdo chos gsal ba/ brjod bya gya nom zhing rjod byed go bde ba 'is/ red/ṭwāṃ slorīsgyu lko nya mirigs dpe skrunakhang /

dngha 4 shlaugyio ci ྾ ri ci ci ci me tsho mori ci 5 ci sna sgo rgyuci ci lke / ( 2/ ci chi dro nywa nag pa ba res ni / 196 0 lor mdo smad bong stag tu skyes/ 19ra 5lor mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo nas thon/ snga phyir snyan ngag dang / lhug rtsom/brtsams sgrung sogs rtsom sna mang po spel/ da lta krung go'i rtsom pa po'i mthun tshogs kyi khongs mi yin zhing /mtsho nub dge 'os slob grwa ru phyag las gnang bzhin yod/
mkha' la 'phyo ba'i yid kyi brtse rlabs/nywa nag pa ba res kyis brtsams/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

dpe skrun gsal bshad/bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed zab tu spel ba'i rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dus bzang 'dir/ 'dzam bu'i dge mtshan 'phang du mtho ba'i gling 'di'i kha btags dkar po dar sa'i yul du dngos po'i dpal yon dbyar chu'i rgyun la 'gran bzhin 'phel ba dang chabs cig bsam pa'i dpal yon gyi mtshar sdug dga' tshal du'ang rig pa'i me tog dag gis phan tshun lang tsho'i sgeg nyams 'gran bzhin 'dzum zhal lhug por grol ba kun gyi gzigs mor gyur pa 'di ko lags shing / de las kyang lhag par bod kyi rtsom rig sdug gu mas zur mig yon por rgyun chags su 'phen pa des yid kyi brtan pa cig car du 'phrog pa'i myong ba kun gyis nyams su myangs dang myong mus su mchis pa 'di bzhin no/ /bod kyi rtsom rig la rtsal shugs rgyas pa dang bstun/ zab yangs mkhyen rab 'dabs ma'i rtsal rdzogs pa'i bod kyi na gzhon rtsom pa po skor zhig mgyogs myur ngang 'tshar longs byung zhing / khong rnam pas rang rang gi thun min gyi khyad zos rtsal du bton nas brtsams pa'i rtsom rig gam rig gzhung skor gyi ljags rtsom mang po zhig la spyi tshogs nas bsngags brjod me tog rnam par gtor zhing gdeng 'jog kyang tshad mthon po byas/1

nged dpe skrun khang gis yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel ba'i bod kyi rtsom rig sngar las gra rgyas phun sum tshogs shing dus rabs kyi 'gros kha dang mthun pa bya ched dang nang sgos lo 'di shas ring grub 'bras gzengs su mtho ba'i na gzhon rtsom pa po skor zhig la skul ma gtong phyir / ched dmigs kyis‘‘gsar rtsom gangs ri'i lang tsho ’zhes pa'i dpe tshogs 'di dpad du bskrun rgyu'i 'char bkod bton pa na/ bod kyi rig gnas la byams brtse che ba'i dpyod ldan mang po zhig gis nged dpe skrun khang gi 'char bkod la bsngags brjod dang rgyab skyor gnang ba dang lhag par du gzhan phan snang bas yongs su nyakhyud cing / dus rabs kyi gzigs rtogs mngon par mtho ba/ bod kyi rig gnas la nam mkha'i lha mo bzhin lhag par byams brtse che ba'i mdo smad rnga yul gyi tshong rams pa rnams kyis nor gyi mchog ni gtong phod pa zhes pa'i mes po'i zhal lung dri ma med pa nyams su blangs te/ lo rer deb gnyis dang khyon bsdoms deb chibacu'i dpe skrun gyi 'gro gron ma dngul sgor khri phrag du ma'i mthun rkyen bsgrub rgyu zhal gyis bzhes pas/ tshogs shing dus la bab pa na 'bras bu thams cad smin par 'gyur zhes pa bzhin/ legs bltas rten 'brel du ma ngang gis 'du zhing bzang po gsum 'dzoms kyi bkra shis mtshan ma rang bzhin gyis shar ba na/ bsam zhing bsam zhing 'dun ma legs nas gda' snyam pa'i nyams rtogs 'gag med du 'char bas/'di ni bod kyi rig gnas gong du 'phel ba'i rten 'brel yin pas/'dir nged cag gis rgya che'i rtsom pa po dang klog pa po/ 'dun bzang 2

rlabs rgyun dang brag rdo/rlabs rgyun dang brag rdo gnyis/mtsho 'gram na kha gtad du langs/lo ngo stong phrag gi ring /mkha' la 'phyo ba'i rlabs rgyun gyis/brag rdo'i ngos la lan brgyar brdabs/bsub med dpang rtags kyi ri mo zhig kyang /brag rdo'i rked pa na gzugs su grub/'jags mi thub pa rlabs kyi chos nyid/'gyur mi srid pa brag rdo'i rang bzhin/dza drag gi 'brel 'dris kyis/mdza' mthun gyi nya mo bskyangs/ 1988 10 7

'tshol zhib/bla srog gson po zhig gi tshab tu/gna' gtam ring mo zhig khyer nas 'ongs kyang /nga rang rtswa thang nas ljongs rgyur chas skabs/g.yag ded kyi rtogs brjod/sngar song yod tshad kyi rnam shes min la/nga rang dga' ba'i lha de yang /mes po las cha 'jog med pas/ngas ri sgang gi lam phran der bltas nas/yang bskyar dri ba bton/1991 12 6

'a cag dag ther byed pa'i slad du yin/gshegs zin pa rnams kyi bshul lam brgyud nas/'tsho bzhin pa dag gi bar gseng nyul skabs/‘‘sa gzhi ni drin du che na/nam mkha' 'di ci zhig yin nam’’bdag dang grogs po rnams de ltar/dri ba stong phrag gi sne la rtsal gyis 'jus nas/mtha' yas pa'i spang ljongs su 'grims pa/dus rabs dang lo rgyus kyi skyogs mtshams 'di nas/'a cag dag ther byed pa'i slad du yin/1992 7 8

mtsho sngon po/rgyang mthong bzung nas/thag ring du rgyang lta byed dus/yod tshad smig rgyu'i grong khyer dang 'dra la/lha sgrung rnams 'di nas 'phur chog chog yin yang /mthing mdog gi 'jig rten de nam mkha' min pas/u tshugs kyis bsgrigs pa'i gtam rgyud dag la/nga rang yid ches bral te/som nyi'i ngang mtsho 'gram du langs/ring nas ring du snying dbus kho nar/btang snyoms su 'jog 'os pa'i tshor ba de/mkha' la rtsen pa'i rlabs ltar 'jags thabs bral zhing/grang shur shur du 'ongs pa'i lhags rlung lus la zugachu klong du lhung ba'i nyi zer la/ci yang 'dri mi phod kyang /lis pa'es gdung dbyangs gyer nas song rjes/bdag ni spro glu len par mos/1991 12 185

gnyan po gsang ba/ su la'ang cha rgyus med stabs/khyod nam mkha' nas babs pa kho na zhig tu gyur te/rgyal rabs lnga yi lo zla'i khrod/sa rdo dang mnyam du rmi lam med pa'i gnyid du yur/ka mad sum cu bod yul du thon dus/ khyod dang gangs ri dkar po gtam rgyud du bris shing /rjes sor gyi lo zla ring mo'i nang /khyod dang 'bre95 ba'i 'du shes kyi 'phel 'grib rnams/mngar la skyur ba'i ro dang 'dres/lo zla sngar ba'in sngon nas sngon la bsrings/bsam gzhigs gsar pa zhig bod yul du thon dus /khyod ni ji 'dra'i ming don mi mtshungs pa zhig yin mod/gang ltar yang bdag dang khyod kyi bar thag ni/ lo rgyus yin/ 1989 10 8

rtsed thang /ri rab dang ljon tshal la gzhi bcol ba nas bzung /tshe srog gi bzhur rgyun zhig 'di nas chas te/'jig rten rang nyid dang 'dra bar gtam du grags shing /rtag tu mtshams 'jog med par mdun nas mdun du bskyod/bran du rung ba'i gnam sa rgya yan du shor bas/the gtogs ni sus kyang mi 'dod mod/mno bsam dang brtse dung la grim lhod shor rkyen/bu chung gi sor rtses bskrun pa'i rnam thar las/ pha rgan dang pha rgan gyi gdung rabs bor/spre'u rnams lha sgrung la 'jigs nas/'gro yul bral ba'i rnam shes brag car 'khor/nam yang dbang phyogs nas 'phags pa'i nyi zla'i 'ogaci yang smra mi shes pa'i rtsed thang giri chur 'khyud pa'i tshe srog gi bzhur rgyun/'jig rten rang nyid dang 'dra bar gtam du grags shing /rtag tu mtshams 'jog med par ma dun nas mdun du bskyod 1991 12 37

lha sa/khyod kyis lo rgyus kyi rkang lam ded de/ skabs 'gar dgod myong la/ skabs 'gar shum yang myong /nam rgyun du chol ga gsum gyi/rmi lam dang re smon 'di nas 'phrad dus/bdag gis khyod la bltas te/rdzogs mtha' med pa'i zhe khong gi snying gtam/mgo brtsams pa yin/rgas 'gyur ni chos nyid yin yang /thams cad las dbang ga la yin/khyod gtor dka' ba'i gtan srol zhig dang /kha gtad du langs thing /song ma tshar ba'i zhabs rjes la phyi mig lta skabs/gangs ljongs kyi ri bo thams cad dang /gtsang po yod tshad khyod la phyogs te/phyogs ba'i mtshams brgyad nas/dbyangs su bkug pa'i 'bod pa/khyod kyi 'od 'tsher ba'i 'byung 'gyur lags/1991 12 48

stod kyi nyi ma/'bru chur brgal dus/mtshan mo'i rked du slebs/ zla ba med kyang gangs ri zla las gsal/mdun phyogs kyi rkang lam dmar por gyur/yid du 'ong ba'i mtshams sprin min/stod kyi nyi ma gnam mtha' nas shar tshe/dbus kyi me tog ma rnying snyems pa'i gtam rgyud sgroga.a myes kyi dur btab pa'i sa na/a pha yang rgas kyi gnyer mas non/rma 'gram gyi pha sa pha yul/gangs ri'i rmi lam gyi khrod nas 'phur ba/bar dor 'khyams pa'i rnam shes min //stod kyi nyi ma gnam mtha' nas shar tshe/thams cad snying nye ba'i ma gcig gi spun zla lags/stod na nyi ma'i 'khor dang /mkha' na nyi ma'i khyim rgyud / 1990 5 7

gangs ti se/snyan 'jebs ldan pa'i gangs ri'i tha snyad khyod la bris shing /dad pa dang brtse zhen yod pa nas/thun mong dang thun min gyi rtogs 'char las/khyod kyi 'dzum mdangs yal ma myong /kha char dang lhags rlung ci 'dra tsub na yang /khyod kyis smug sprin gyi bang rim re re brtol te/gzi 'od 'bar ba'i gangs ri stong phrag la sne khrid mdzad/'phrul snang min pa'i khyod kyi ngo mtshar rol dbyangs la gsan bzhin/a ti shas 'di nas bcibs kha lhod cing /rje btsun mi la ras pas rdzu 'phrul ngom pa ltar/ lo rgyus rnams khyod kyi spyan lam nas yal dus/bgrod dka' ba'i mtha' 'khor gyi gcong rong de dgakhyod kyi thugs su bris pa'i rma kha'ang yin srid/khyod nyi zla'i 'od snang la rtag tu dga' zhing /mi rigs kyi la rgya mkha' nas mkha' ru btegs te/ltosprin dang 'ja' tshon gyi dbus nas bskyod skabs/dus rabs gsar pa'i rlabs chen gyi bya gzhag dang /nga tsho'i zhe khong gi glu dbyangs khyod la dbang ba yin/1991 12 710

nga ni mtho sgang gi gzhom bral che srog cig yin/ngas sa rdo rus lha ru bkur zhing /ngas thogs reg bral ba'i nam mkha' dang /myang 'das kyi sangs rgyas kyang mchod/'u dum btsan 'phyis drags pa'i rkyen gyis/lo rgyus gcong rong du lhung /'bangs gyen log gi dza drag 'thab rtsod las/ngas sha khrag rus gsum ri lung kun tu btab/nga grub mtha' dang lhan du 'dres nas/rab rib kyi khrod du yod tshad la gdong bsu byas/nga 'od zer zhig gi sne mor 'jus pa nas bzung /chad lhag shor ba'i rang rnam ngag la skyor bzhin/'byung 'gyur gyi ched du phyilpog bltas shing /skya rengs kyi don du gom kha phyogs dus/nga ni drag tu rgyu ba'i rbab chu la co 'dri ba'i/mtho sgang gi gzhom bral tshe srog cig yin/1992 9 1011

rdo sgrog gu/ge sar dang rkyang rgod gshegs pa'i shul lam/zhen rnyi las shor ba'i lo zlas khyer/char rlung gi khrod na rdo sgrog gu'i(ze/ dbyibs ris/sngar bzhin gsal ler lhang nge /dran gzhigs kyi snye lo g.yo bar byas 'ong / mal na khom pa'i bgres po zungs zad cig gis/tshe mjug gi nyi ma 'khyol phyir/rdo sgrog gu dang 'brel ba'i spro sgrung dgaslar yang bklags nas rang sems gsos/bde snang gis rtsed mor g.yeng ba'i byis pa 'gas kyang /khar thon gyi tshig rkang re gnyis ngag la bskyor/byung 'das rnams shor zhing rgas na'ang /rnam rtog dang srog snying dben pa'i rdo sgrog gu de/ge sar gyi gzi byin thon pa ji bzhin/btsan po dang gnyom chung 'grig pa'i/mna' dpang du gyur 'dug1991 4 5mchan/ /dungag rgyun du ge sar rgyal po sprul myong zer ba'i rdo pha bong zhig14
